notes:
Copilot CLI Chat 0.2.0 (beta)

- Implement M1 Copilot CLI chat extension for VS Code
- Implement M1.5 independent working roots and reasoning effort controls
- Implement Visual Studio ACP chat and IDE tools with settings and remembered permissions

Packages: VS Code Windows x64 / ARM64 / macOS Apple Silicon, and Visual Studio 2022 17.8+ (x64 / ARM64).

Install VS Code packages with Extensions > Install from VSIX; choose the extension host's OS/CPU. The bundled SDK needs host Node ^20.19 or >=22.12. For Visual Studio, close VS and run the VSIX installer; install and authenticate the external Copilot CLI first. A GitHub account with Copilot access is required.

Beta validation: automated VS Code and VS Core tests, package manifests and runtime isolation. Full manual acceptance and runtime checks on macOS / Windows x64 / company VS environments remain pending. ACP is public preview. No automatic updater or Marketplace publication is included.
